top_signals.title: Asian Stocks, Bonds Decline as Crude Oil Advances: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks and bonds fell as rising oil prices fueled inflation concerns and the prospect of tighter monetary policy, driving a risk-off tone across markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. urges hands-off approach to AI regulation at G20 tech meeting
top_signals.summary: The U.S. goals largely align with the thinking of the world's biggest artificial intelligence companies, nearly all of which are American.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
